title_cyr: Подигни си мило либе бело крпе
title_latin: Podigni si milo libe belo krpe
title_en: Lift your white kerchief, dear love
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional. Last line is my reading: 'for Janeta' probably means promised to a man named Janeta/Jane (a male name) in the neighboring family.

lines.cyr: - Подигни си мило либе бело крпе
lines.lat: - Podigni si milo libe belo krpe
lines.en: - Lift your white kerchief, dear love

lines.cyr: да ти видам мило либе бело лице.
lines.lat: da ti vidam milo libe belo lice.
lines.en: so I can see your white face, dear love.

lines.cyr: - И да видиш, лудо младо, фајде нема
lines.lat: - I da vidiš, ludo mlado, fajde nema
lines.en: - And even if you see it, foolish young man, it is no use,
my white face, foolish young man, is sold.
Sold, foolish young man, to the neighbors

lines.cyr: во комшии, лудо младо, за Јанета.
lines.lat: vo komšii, ludo mlado, za Janeta.
lines.en: to the neighbors, foolish young man, for Janeta.
